quarterly_data.quarter: INNIO press release: INNIO Secures 450 MW Order to Power Next-Generation Data (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: INNIO secured a firm order from a U.S. energy company (name not disclosed, in line with data center industry confidentiality practices) for 450 MW of power infrastructure: Jenbacher J624 containerized gas engines to support prime power solutions for large-scale data center projects in North America. The order was booked in Q3 2026, the engines are expected to be delivered by 2028, and it is the customer's first order of this scale. CEO Olaf Berlien: 'AI is driving unprecedented demand for power, while grid constraints have become a critical bottleneck for data center development.' The company says the J624 'has set the industry standard for high-speed engines in its power class', citing superior power density, ease of transport, containerization for fast deployment, more stable load-following and lower redundancy requirements.
quarterly_data.figure: 450 MW firm order; booked Q3 2026; delivery by 2028
